mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 58 degrees and a waxing crescent moon. Tonight, you can spot the ISS rising over Cross Plains toward Madison starting at 9:11 PM. Expect an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, officers were dispatched to Hunter's Cove Way on September 10th for a burglary in progress. A 19-year-old suspect was apprehended after a gunshot was heard, and a handgun was recovered at the scene.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival happening today. You can also enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or check out yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness.

Regarding the police department's report, on September 10th, officers successfully took a suspect into custody following a residential burglary where a firearm was discharged, though fortunately, no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 49 minutes, so be sure to stop by before 10:00 PM.
